{{Top}}
'''Class Two infractions''' were one of the five categories of crime outlined in the [[Imperial Penal Code/Legends|Imperial Penal Code]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]] alongside [[Class Five infraction/Legends|Class Five]], [[Class Four infraction/Legends|Class Four]], [[Class Three infraction/Legends|Class Three]] and [[Class One infraction/Legends|Class One]] infractions.<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref> Crimes in this category included, but were not limited to: 
*Shipment of high-energy weapons between [[Star system/Legends|systems]] without a special permit issued by the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]]
*Purchase of illegal goods
*Transportation of illegal goods

Being the most serious offense in Imperial Law after [[Class One infraction/Legends|Class One infractions]], the law was rarely ignored and enforced even on the further edges of civilized space.<ref name="GG6" /> Standard Imperial punishment for this type of violation included a fine of 10.000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and 5 to 30 [[Standard_year/Legends|years]] of [[Prison/Legends|jail]] for all offenders. In case a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] crew was found guilty of a Class Two infraction, their vessel was also impounded until claimed by the owner.<ref name="GG6.2e">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters (Second Edition)]]</ref>
